en.title: Jesus Meets the Women of Jerusalem
en.meditation:
Consider how those women wept with compassion at seeing Jesus in such a pitiable state, streaming with blood, as He walked along. But Jesus said to them: Weep not for Me, but for your children.

My Jesus, laden with sorrows, I weep for the offences I have committed against Thee, because of the pains they have deserved, and still more because of the displeasure they have caused Thee, who hast loved me so much. It is Thy love, more than the fear of hell, which causes me to weep for my sins. My Jesus, I love Thee more than myself; I repent of having offended Thee. Never permit me to offend Thee again. Grant that I may love Thee always; and then do with me what Thou wilt.
en.versicle: We adore Thee, O Christ, and we bless Thee.
en.response: Because by Thy holy Cross, Thou hast redeemed the world.
en.source: eCatholic2000.com, "The Way of the Cross" by St. Alphonsus de Liguori, https://www.ecatholic2000.com/liguori/stations/cross.shtml, retrieved 2026-08-23

fr.title: Jésus adresse la parole aux femmes de Jérusalem
fr.meditation:
Considérons comment à la vue de Jésus si maltraité et arrosant le chemin de son sang, les femmes pleuraient de compassion : « Ne pleurez pas sur moi » leur dit Jésus ; « mais pleurez sur vous-mêmes et sur vos enfants. »

Mon Jésus accablé de douleurs, je regrette les offenses que je Vous ai faites, à cause des châtiments que j’ai mérités ; mais surtout à cause de la peine que je vous ai causée, à Vous qui m’avez tant aimé.
fr.versicle: Nous t’adorons, ô Christ, et nous te bénissons,
fr.response: parce que tu as racheté le monde par ta sainte Croix.
fr.source: spiritualite-chretienne.com, "Chemin de Croix avec les meditations de St Alphonse de Liguori" (site now defunct/repurposed; archived via Wayback Machine, e.g. https://web.archive.org/web/20200221112546/http://www.spiritualite-chretienne.com/croix/stat-c01.html), retrieved 2026-08-23 -- provisional pending AELF licence, per content/README.md (meditation); Diocese de Saint-Etienne (diocese-saintetienne.fr), "Chemin de Croix", https://www.diocese-saintetienne.fr/wp-content/uploads/2020/04/Chemin-de-croix.pdf, retrieved 2026-08-23 -- provisional pending AELF licence, per content/README.md (versicle/response)
